_comment: Head & neck: brainstem, parotid_L, parotid_R, mandible, spinal_cord (6 classes incl. background).
_note_ssim_floors: Floors calibrated to observed head_neck validation range (epochs 1–35). CT→MR SSIM has never dropped below 0.845 after epoch 6; setting floor to 0.84 makes the guard actually protective rather than decorative. Base config default of 0.75 is far below observed performance and would allow a badly collapsed CT→MRI direction to still save best_model.pth.
_note_class_weights: Median-frequency balancing. Approx voxel fractions: brainstem~1.5%, parotid_L~1%, parotid_R~1%, mandible~3%, spinal_cord~0.8%. Run scripts/compute_class_weights.py to recompute from your training split.
